name: Applied Operations Research
description:
Primary objective of the course is to demonstrate students the real application of Operations Research in decision making. The approach of the course would be a case based. Case study either from Ivey or Harvard or some top journals would be considered for discussion at every session. These case study will be related to have some application in industry (manufacturing or services). 
It is assumed or expected that all students registered in this course have done basic course on Operations Research.
